end.summary: Practised sums of consecutive odd numbers and their square-number pattern.
end.parentNote: Saanvi practised showing square numbers with dot arrays and pairing consecutive triangular numbers. They used rows and columns to explain why 10 + 15 = 25 and checked 78 + 91 = 169. They initially treated a few examples as enough proof that a pattern always works; this mix-up was not fully corrected by the end. At home, ask them to draw a dot picture for one new case and explain why the arrangement works, not only calculate the answer.
